title: Kalah Foundation
tagline: The first ever permissionless competetive kalah platform governed by law of code and math
description: The "Kalah foundation" project is aiming to be an innovative decentralized gaming platform that brings classic board games, starting with Kalah, onto various blockchain networks such as Optimism, Base and more. The platform enables players to engage in exciting matches of Kalah against each other in a trustless and transparent environment. Players can create their game rooms or join existing ones, challenging friends or other users from around the world to a game of Kalah.
how_its_made: In the core lies the Kalah contract which enables one to create & join games. By leveraging Base, Optimism & Zora players have to opportunity to play on their favorite chain or the one they are most used to, and also bring cheap interactions & overall a better ux for the players. Furthermore, the data indexed from these chains by The graph makes the game exploring a smooth experience. Furthermore what we are most proud of is our verification system using worldcoin, players have the opportunity to create games where only orb-verified players can join hence providing complete sybil resistance for the game.
